title: test-a-loop-a-test-run-starts-is-the-runs-reaches-the-tester-only-through-cairn-test
intention: test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs reaches the tester only through cairn test: its tooth runs the fixture proof via `bin/cairn test` instead of importing TesterDevice, and checks the loop unit is gone the same way.
why: Committing 2c9eeab2da87 (cairn 1425bc54) resealed cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py RED (trouble seal-red-cairn-devices-tester): cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py:127 imports cairn.devices.tester.device, a reach from tools/base into a device that RULE 1 forbids (the tester publishes `cairn test`, nothing importable). Added in 9e04330c for 2120e74dcf44 (PROVED). The lived symptom: the tester component reads red for a breach that is not its own, so every tester ticket's color is wrong until it moves.
traces_to: RULE 1 (a component talks to another only through its public interface); Law 9 (the tester's red must be earned by its own code).
how: In cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py test_a_tester_run_that_starts_a_loop_leaves_no_unit (line ~127): drop `from cairn.devices.tester.device import TesterDevice` and the run_proof call; run [<repo>/bin/cairn, test, <fixture proof path>] with subprocess, assert exit 0 and a `green` line for the fixture in stdout, then assert _gone(unit) exactly as now. The proof's bytes move, so the reseal needs the rung-4 ruling (cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:202-224), asked as the question bound to this ticket.
falsifier: Done when (1) cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py is green (encapsulation_breaches carries no row from cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py); (2) cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py is green with the fixture run through `bin/cairn test`, and its unit tooth still reds when kill_what_it_started is taken away (hollow). WRONG INTENT if `cairn test` cannot run a proof outside the repo tree, in which case the fixture moves under a scratch repo path and the falsifier stands.
watchme: none, because cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py reds on any new reach via the encapsulation_breaches sieve
children: none, because one tooth in one proof file
